project: Volatility-Regime & Reversal Indicator — Phase 3 (decomposed-surface top watch-state + Zweig-thrust bottom; TODO #47)
description: Build the free 'Phase 3' two-track market top/bottom detector per /root/.claude/plans/look-at-47-on-humble-raven.md, reusing the existing frozen honesty harness (NOTHING in Phase 1 or Phase 2 is touched). Track A: a new variance-risk-premium feature, a 4-leg top WATCH-STATE composite, a 2-stage watch->price-break TRIGGER, a capitulation->Zweig-breadth-thrust BOTTOM detector + controls, a trend-following benchmark battle, a frozen preregistration_phase3.yaml with a 7-gate kill-gate + alert budget, a run_phase3.py runner producing PHASE3-REPORT.md, and new look-ahead + preregistration tests. Track B: two new daily collectors (CBOE put/call ratio; true NYSE up/down volume) verified against a real free source, plus a scheduled daily job, to accumulate forward history that cannot be backfilled. Honest NO-GO is acceptable and ships descriptive-only. Working dir: volatility_regime_reversal_indicator/.

stories.title: Track A1: VRP + Zweig point-in-time features with look-ahead coverage
acceptanceCriteria: src/features/utils.py gains variance_risk_premium(vix_close, spy_close, rv_window=21) = (vix_close/100)**2 - realized_vol(spy_close, rv_window, annualize=True)**2, reusing the existing realized_vol; trailing-only, no full-sample stats
src/features/utils.py gains zweig_breadth_thrust(adv, dec, ema_span=10) = ema(adv/(adv+dec), 10) reusing the existing causal ema
tests/test_lookahead.py registers both new functions and the truncation-invariance test passes for them (feature[t] on data[0..t] == feature[t] on full series)
python3 -m pytest tests/test_lookahead.py -q passes with the two new entries present

stories.title: Track A2-A5: Phase-3 conditions module (watch-state, trigger, Zweig bottom, controls, benchmarks)
acceptanceCriteria: NEW src/signals/conditions_phase3.py mirrors conditions_phase2.py structure (_b, _col, leg fns, @dataclass(frozen=True) P3Construction(name, side, fn, role), build_constructions())

top_watch_state(p) is a geometric mean (copy distribution_stress_index machinery) of 4 signed monotonic trailing-252-percentile legs oriented HIGH=top-like: (1) 1-pct(variance_risk_premium) [low VRP=complacency], (2) pct(VIX/VIX3M term ratio), (3) pct(_vvix_residual) reused from Phase 2, (4) 1-pct(concentration_regime(p,60))
t_watch_break(p, watch_pct=0.80, ma=50) = (trailing_percentile(top_watch_state,252) >= watch_pct) & (SPY_close < sma(SPY_close,50)); registered side='top' role='primary' + >=1 variant

zbt_fire(p, span=10, lo=0.40, hi=0.615, within=10) implements the classic Zweig trigger from ABINYSE_adv/ABINYSE_dec using only trailing ops (shift, rolling().max().shift(1)); b_thrust(p) = capitulation washout (reuse _capit dd<=-0.08 & VIX>90pct) & zbt_fire; registered side='bottom' role='primary' + a looser variant

Two bottom CONTROLS registered (zbt_only, washout_only) to prove the thrust requirement is load-bearing; benchmark constructions bench_top_200 (SPY<sma200) and bench_bot_200 (SPY>sma200) registered role='benchmark'

build_constructions() returns all of the above; importing the module and calling each fn on the real loaded panel returns a boolean Series aligned to the index (no exception, no all-NaN top_watch_state after warmup)

stories.title: Track A7: phase3.py scorer + run_phase3.py runner producing PHASE3-REPORT.md
acceptanceCriteria: NEW src/backtest/phase3.py imports phase2 and adds episodes_per_year, alert_budget_compliance(sig,index,lo,hi), and beats_benchmark(...) (matched-alert-count bootstrap copied from stack_beats_parts; detector must have diff_p05>0 vs the 200-day baseline)

NEW src/run_phase3.py mirrors run_phase2.py: loads the 14 series, forward_event_hits([8,15],60), vol_regime_labels, scores every P3Construction via the UNCHANGED score_construction, runs the OOS battery (_precision_in_window discover/confirm, qqq_view transfer, leave_one_episode_out, max_stat_reality) on the best top, plus beats_benchmark + alert_budget_compliance for best top and best bottom
Verdict = g1..g5 (reused Phase-2 gates) AND g6 (benchmark battle both sides) AND g7 (alert budget both sides); the 7-line kill-gate verdict ends GO or NO-GO
